_comment: FX-census divergences, declared deliberately (loud-stub doctrine: silent rows must be either a precondition no-op in EXPECTED_SILENT, page-invisible in FX_NOOBSERVE, or registered here with the control's REAL behavior verified in source/probes). Keyed by '<ribbon-tab>|<control-id>' so a per-tab regression can never hide behind another tab's loud row. Same honesty rules as interact-divergences.json: every entry needs a verified date and a source/probe reference.

Home|btn-copy-style.real: Format painter is a TipTap-era feature; the canvas editor has no engine copy-style/format-painter path (word-commands copyStyle 1066 reads run formatting then apply_formatting only for TipTap). Click is routed but produces no observable change on canvas.
Home|btn-copy-style.oo: OO format painter copies source formatting to the next clicked range

PluginsPlugins|btn-copy-style.real: Same format painter gap as the Home-tab instance (duplicate id, same command path).

DrawDraw|btn-draw-select.real: Draw-tab marquee/object select requires an ink/shape surface; the canvas port has none. No observable change.

DrawDraw|btn-draw-eraser.real: Ink eraser requires an ink surface; the canvas port has none. No observable change.

DrawDraw|sel-draw-language-select.real: Language select writes documentStore language state only; the canvas editor has no spellcheck-language surface to observe.
DrawDraw|sel-draw-language-select.oo: OO sets proofing language with visible status feedback

DrawDraw|btn-draw-set-language.real: Same store-only language write as the select sibling.

CollaborationCollaboration|btn-track-cha.real: toggleTrackChanges flips documentStore.trackChanges but neither the ribbon button (no aria-pressed binding for plain buttons) nor the statusbar mirrors the flag on canvas, so the toggle has no observable surface.
CollaborationCollaboration|btn-track-cha.oo: OO shows track-changes state on the ribbon toggle and statusbar
CollaborationCollaboration|btn-track-cha.verified: 2026-11-19 word-commands.ts:1009 + ControlRenderer (no aria-pressed for type button)

LayoutLayout|btn-line-numbers.real: setLineNumbersEnabled flips store state; no canvas renderer or DOM surface consumes it.

Home|btn-set-document-language.real: setLanguage writes store state only; no canvas/DOM surface observes the document language.
Home|btn-set-document-language.oo: OO opens a language dialog and reflects the choice in proofing UI

LayoutLayout|btn-insert-field.real: At-rest field insert falls back to the TipTap rte path (onRichTextCommand insertField) which is a no-op on the canvas editor; the canvas engine has no field-insert op yet.
LayoutLayout|btn-insert-field.oo: OO inserts a PAGE/NUMPAGES field at the cursor

Home|btn-fit-to-width.real: setFitToWidth(true) writes store state; the statusbar only mirrors fitToPage, so fit-to-width has no observable surface.
Home|btn-fit-to-width.oo: OO zooms the page to fit the window width (zoom % changes)

Chart DesignChart Design|btn-update-char.real: Chart-data update requires an inserted/selected chart; the census doc has none, so the click is context-bound dead.
Chart DesignChart Design|btn-update-char.oo: OO opens the chart data editor for the selected chart
Chart DesignChart Design|btn-update-char.verified: 2026-11-19 fx probe (all signals static; census doc is chartless)

Chart DesignChart Design|sel-chart-width.real: Chart sizing requires an inserted chart; context-bound dead on the chartless census doc.

Chart DesignChart Design|sel-chart-heigh.real: Chart sizing requires an inserted chart; context-bound dead on the chartless census doc.

InsertInsert|btn-insert-field.real: Duplicate of the Layout-tab insert-field: at-rest field insert falls back to the TipTap rte path (no-op on canvas); the canvas engine has no field-insert op yet.
InsertInsert|btn-insert-field.oo: OO inserts a PAGE/NUMPAGES field at the cursor

DrawDraw|btn-draw-cut.real: Draw-tab cut requires an ink surface; the canvas port has none. No observable change.

LayoutLayout|btn-page-orientation.real: Dispatches world-office:page-layout with the CURRENT orientation value (the ribbon button carries no dropdown choice), so the layout container style is unchanged — a designed no-op at rest. OO opens a portrait/landscape dialog instead.

LayoutLayout|btn-page-size.real: Same designed no-op as page-orientation: dispatches the current page size (A4) with no value source, so the container style is unchanged. OO opens a page-size dialog.

Chart DesignChart Design|sel-chart-wrapp.real: Chart text wrapping requires an inserted chart; context-bound dead on the chartless census doc.
Chart DesignChart Design|sel-chart-wrapp.oo: OO wraps text around the selected chart

PluginsPlugins|btn-word-count.real: Duplicate of the Home-tab word-count (status-loud there). Silent on the Plugins tab in the census walk — suspected right-panel toggle race after the AI tab walk; monitor on next runs.
PluginsPlugins|btn-word-count.verified: 2026-11-19 fx-debug43 (Home instance status-loud, Plugins instance silent)

Chart DesignChart Design|sel-chart-type.real: Chart type select requires an inserted chart; context-bound dead on the chartless census doc.
Chart DesignChart Design|sel-chart-type.oo: OO changes the selected chart's type

ViewView|btn-record-macro.real: recordMacro flips documentStore.macroRecording but no statusbar/ribbon surface mirrors the recording state on the canvas editor (OO shows a REC indicator and records commands). Store-only toggle — observability debt; its sibling pause-recording is an EXPECTED_SILENT precondition row.
ViewView|btn-record-macro.oo: OO records a macro with a visible REC indicator
ViewView|btn-record-macro.verified: 2026-11-19 DocumentStore.ts:437 toggleMacroRecording (zero tsx consumers) + fx-debug45/gate flip-flop
